newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq can handle 6 mln bbls/day of oil production.
newsitem.headline: Iraq can handle 6 mln bbls/day of oil production.

text.p: Iraq now has the pipelines and facilities to handle oil production of six million barrels per day (bpd), a level it could reach five years after the U.N. drops its sanctions against Iraq, a senior oil official said in remarks published Saturday.

"Iraqi oil pipelines and the current capacities of ports have the ability to handle six million bpd five years from the date the embargo on the country is removed," Sami Sharif, oil ministry undersecretary, told the government newspaper al-Jumhouriya.
